chunks: And ʿAbd al-Raḥmān ibn al-Ḥajjāj asked Abā al-Ḥasan عليه السلام:
About a woman who gives birth after al-ʿAṣr: should she complete that day, or break her fast? He said: "She should break her fast, then make up that day."

key_terms.الْمَرْأَةِ: the woman being asked about in the ruling
key_terms.تَقْضِي: makes up the missed fast later

ai.seo_question: If a woman gives birth after al-ʿAṣr during Ramadan, should she complete her fast or break it?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning a woman who gives birth after al-ʿAṣr while fasting. The Imam عليه السلام states that she should break her fast and later make up that day, indicating that the fast is not to be completed after childbirth begins.
